issues.description: The template calls stim.Circuit(p) in simulate_msd_two_rounds, passing the depolarization probability p into the stim.Circuit constructor. The stim.Circuit constructor does not accept a probability parameter; the solution and typical usage construct stim.Circuit() with no arguments. This mismatch will cause a runtime error and confuse students implementing simulate_msd_two_rounds.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the incorrect argument and construct the circuit with stim.Circuit() in the template. Update the template simulate_msd_two_rounds to use circ = stim.Circuit() (matching the solution) so students are not misled by an invalid constructor call.
